notes.title: Update 1.46 available!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!
A new update (1.46) is today available for the game, check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173740/Woodle_Tree_2_Deluxe/


[h3]It includes:[/h3]
- Co-op 4 players mode multiplayer fixes for both local and remote play together
- Improved combat game design
- perfected gamepad vibrations
- Woodle movements fixes
- Minor others bug fixes



Have fun!
